<!-- pr-reviewer: b9209b0b07d1d547e4a4f76bbb50bfdb1ef97b9a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The safety review found no blocking items. The overlap repeats the fitted lines and arcs. An interior exit splits both laps at the same point. The crossing check stays active.

Local results against upstream/main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f`:

- The trial merge needed no changes. The PR contains current main.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. Motion unit tests: 401 passed, 6 ignored. Contour-start tests: 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.
- After both mutations, the restored contour-start suite passed all 14 tests. The worktree has no source changes.

I ran these two mutations locally:

1. Restored the upstream version of `contour_start.rs`. All three new tests failed with XY feed crossings. The failures included pairs `[5, 15]` and `[5, 17]`.
2. Disabled only the first-lap interior split. The interior-arc test failed with crossing pairs `[5, 14]` and `[22, 31]`.

No goldens moved. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required. The decision record and the PR body describe the change and its tests.

Requested changes: none.

Scope: I did not run the app, MCP, post, batch, release, or ignored tests. All checks ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
